author: Inside Edition
description:
The slaying of Nicole Brown Simpson and her friend Ronald Goldman is one of the most notorious crimes in American history. But Joseph Perrulli says it could have been him.
Perrulli says he dated Nicole after she split from O.J. Simpson. He tells Inside Edition's Jim Moret that the former football great gave him a death stare he'll never forget. Perrulli's memories of his time with Nicole are recounted in his new book, "The Forgotten Briefcase."

author: Inside Edition
description: New York's Times Square is filled with billboards promoting movies, Broadway shows, and products of every sort. But one New Jersey man's giant sign is about something far more personal. Mark Whitmore has end-stage renal disease, and is seeking a donor. He hopes the 22-foot digital billboard at the so-called 'Crossroads of the World' will encourage someone to donate a kidney.
title: New Jersey Dad Uses Giant Times Square Billboard To Seek Kidney Donor

author: Inside Edition
description: We're getting a look at the man police say caused a big scare at the ‘TODAY’ Show on Thursday. Alexander Truelove allegedly rushed past the show's security and charged at one of the co-hosts, Craig Melvin, while using racial slurs. The NYPD arrested Truelove, and he is facing two hate crime charges. As Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano reports, this is not his first run-in with the law. Additionally, a security guard at the ‘TODAY’ Show studio has been reportedly fired following the incident.
title: Who Is The Man Accused Of Breaking Into The ‘TODAY’ Show?

author: Inside Edition
description: Mouths dropped across the country earlier this week when video of a grandfather getting tossed in the air by a raging bison went viral. For Emma Williams, the attack brought back horrible memories. Her father, a popular TV reporter named Keith Williams, was killed last year in a bison attack at Caprock Canyons State Park. She spoke with Inside Edition's Justin Finch about that terrible day.
title: Daughter Of TV Reporter Killed In Bison Attack Has Horrible Memories

author: Inside Edition
description: A two decades-long manhunt has come to a close in Rhode Island, authorities say. Ronald L. Fischer was apprehended by the U.S. Coast Guard on a 56- foot sailboat called "The Silver Lining" on Thursday. After fleeing custody in 2005, Fischer, a former anesthesiologist , was convicted in absentia of raping a woman in 2003. His case was featured several times on "America's Most Wanted." Inside Edition's Jim Moret has the details.
title: 'America's Most Wanted' Fugitive Anesthesiologist Caught On Sailboat

author: Inside Edition
description: SeaLife Response, Rehabilitation, and Research is caring for a 3-week-old seal who was shot in the face. The non-profit is managing the pup's pain, making him comfortable, and determining if he needs surgery to remove the projectile. According to Casey Mclean, there has been an increase in pinnipeds getting shot. She thinks it's happening because of misinformation going around about salmon recovery. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Who Shot Baby Seal In The Face?
